name: shopping-agent
description: Search a fixed Shopify API first, with authorized Chrome only as a zero-result fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Search Shopify first; use Chrome only if empty.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.1 searches the fixed Shopify Storefront pilot first and uses authorized Chrome only after a successful zero-product response, without membership, checkout, or payment actions.
defaultPrompt: Use FindCheap-Agent to search Shopify first and use authorized Chrome only when Shopify returns zero products.
